sources.observation: Turn lane values describe indications. Missing indications do not establish a turn ban; independently recorded restrictions must be handled separately. Empty and none denote no indication. Semicolons separate multiple indications within one lane.
Pipe-separated lane rows run left to right in the direction of travel. Forward and backward refer to the original OSM way orientation; backward lane rows are not reversed.
Connectivity relations can describe precise lane connections. Indications and road topology alone do not establish those physical connections.

role: Primary community tagging documentation informing a narrow model grammar, not independent physical or legal access evidence.
